name: Mattaniah
overview: The name Mattaniah appears in Scripture as belonging to various individuals who played significant roles in the worship and leadership of Israel. Notably, Mattaniah was the original name of King Zedekiah of Judah, highlighting his royal heritage. Several Levites named Mattaniah, descendants of Asaph and Heman, were entrusted with musical duties in the temple, including leading the ninth division of musicians, emphasizing their role in temple worship and purification. Additionally, some Israelites named Mattaniah are recorded as part of the faithful who separated from Gentile wives after the captivity, reflecting a commitment to covenantal purity. These references collectively demonstrate Mattaniah’s association with leadership, worship, and faithfulness in Israel’s history.
